verification.focused_regressions: cargo test -p desktop-gpui --lib image_upload: 17 passed (admission, reuse, sharing, counters, pool pruning)
verification.independent_gate: first candidate 7fe5bad: Gate 92249c9f SUCCEEDED 8/8 with cleanup complete; this repaired candidate awaits its own Gate
verification.external_review: round 1 on 7fe5bad: PASS 1 / 1 / 0 HOLD; both findings are repaired in this candidate and observed natively

repaired: a replaced side no longer keeps the previous picture under the new label
a reappearing side moves from the withheld reason to an explicit not-yet-shown state
the Fit control is per-pair in both link states, matching the trace operation
physical 1:1 and cursor-anchored zoom are exported as explicit NOT_MEASURED scopes
a pane camera event no longer claims the interaction origin, so pair-wide controls cannot move the focus Swap returns to
ui.retained: the trace keeps its frozen before-input scene sampling documented in scene_sample_order

blocking: closing Compare with a Viewed candidate outside the pair could not restore that candidate (ADR-0010 D-7); repaired by acquiring its own local input and keeping the loaded picture on close
actionable: a swap with one unavailable side could withdraw the picture it had just attached; repaired by swapping availability with the frames and restating the projection after a swap
external_round_1.additional_repair: refused local preparations now state a user-facing sentence instead of a raw variant name (ADR-0015 Q13)

repaired: idle pool pruning is per pool usage, so an empty sibling pool of a live generation no longer survives; regression added

not_claimed: Production media acquisition and authorized Runtime artifacts (MP-IMG6, MP-RT6)
The five-run x four-variant R5 reuse/fairness matrix (needs MP-R0D and an explicit experiment authorization)
Present, GPU transfer/completion/residency, 8K/16K sources and mixed-DPI native comparison
Runtime projections, formal selection and any command semantics
Product acceptance, main promotion or release
